h2: Casting radiography and weld RT in Tulsa: licensing, reference radiographs and where the work is done
html:
Casting radiography and weld RT in Tulsa: licensing, reference radiographs and where the work is done

Casting radiography services for Tulsa buyers usually mean radiographing valve, pump and fitting castings to a purchase specification, while field radiography covers pipeline and plant welds. Oklahoma is an NRC Agreement State, so gamma radiography there runs under a state-issued radioactive-materials licence rather than an NRC one. Atlantis confirms the radiography arrangements, licence holder and exposure plan for each job before it quotes.

Judging castings. Steel castings are graded against ASTM reference radiographs chosen by section thickness: E446 for sections up to 2 in., E186 for 2 to 4½ in., and E280 for 4½ to 12 in. Each set illustrates gas porosity, sand and slag inclusions and shrinkage at graded severity levels, with cracks and hot tears shown separately, and the purchase specification states which level is acceptable in which zone of the casting. Valve, flange and fitting castings are often bought to MSS SP-54, and steel castings used in pressure vessels are covered by ASME Section VIII Division 1 Appendix 7. A buyer who does not state the reference set, the severity level and the zones in the order leaves the foundry to decide.

Where casting RT is done. Production castings are usually radiographed in a shielded, permanently licensed installation at the foundry or a laboratory. Atlantis does not run a fixed radiography installation in Tulsa. What it offers buyers is review: an ASNT NDT Level III checks the foundry's technique, image quality indicators, density or grey-value range and geometric unsharpness, then re-reads the films or digital images against the reference radiographs. For large or installed castings that cannot travel, field radiography or digital radiography can be mobilised under the licensing arrangements confirmed for that job.

Field weld radiography. Pipeline girth welds are radiographed to API 1104 and the operator's specification; plant piping to ASME B31.3 with the examination performed under ASME Section V Article 2. Field RT needs a controlled exclusion zone, so it is often scheduled for nights or quiet shifts, and when an Oklahoma boiler is repaired, the radiographs become part of the certified repairer's package for the commissioned inspector to review.

Which licence applies. In an Agreement State the state agency issues the radioactive-materials licence, sets its conditions and inspects the licensee. Federal installations are an exception, because government-run facilities can remain under NRC oversight even inside an Agreement State, so radiography on a federal site in Oklahoma is checked against that before the source is booked.

What a casting RT order or review request should state:

  • Material, section thickness and the ASTM reference radiograph set that applies.
  • Acceptable severity level for each discontinuity category, zone by zone.
  • Required coverage, image quality indicator type and the sensitivity to be shown.
  • Whether film or digital images will be supplied, and in what format.

The national radiographic testing service describes film and digital options, procedure development covers RT technique sheets and casting procedures, and Oklahoma inspection services maps the wider state. For technicians, there is radiographic testing training and the radiography simulator. To discuss casting radiography or film review for Tulsa, send the specification and casting details.
